title: Research cash-priority short with an independent bounded sizing budget
head: codex/btc-structure-20261004
body:
Add a research-only negative SX60/SMA60 short when the incumbent would remain cash, preserving owned and fresh incumbent long/macro priority. Risk1, notional/equity≤0.5, and a1% stop/gap/fee/funding sizing reserve bound new short targets; the reserve is not a guaranteed loss cap. Fix consumed macro priority and reuse four SHA/source-bound completed baselines while remeasuring only four affected candidate accounts.

All four registered cold windows show zero added shorts and zero paired gain; reject the candidate and retain original/superseded evidence. Defaults remain unchanged, no795 replay/native enablement/old-ledger rebind. Validation: one final full453 tests,5 skips PASS. GitHub CI intentionally skipped per owner no-repeat preference.
